name: Apron Death Valley Driver to Floor
Axe Kick
description: The leg rises high and the heel is driven downward onto the opponent’s head or upper shoulder.

name: Back Kick
description: The attacker pivots and drives the heel backward into the opponent’s abdomen while beginning face-to-face.

name: Backfist
description: The back of the fist is snapped horizontally into the opponent’s face.

name: Backhand Chop
description: A backhanded open-hand chop is swung into the opponent’s upper chest.

name: Backhand Slap
description: The back of the hand is snapped across the opponent’s face.

name: Bicycle Kick
description: The attacker jumps with a scissoring leg motion and drives the lead boot into the opponent’s head.

name: Bionic Elbow
description: A raised pointed elbow is brought down sharply onto the opponent’s forehead.

name: Body Straight Punch
description: A short straight punch driven into the opponent’s midsection.

name: Crescent Kick
description: A high arcing kick sweeps the inside edge of the foot across the opponent’s face.

name: Cross Chop
description: Both forearms cross inward across the opponent’s upper chest and throat line.

name: Discus Forearm
description: A full pivot powers the forearm across the opponent’s face.

name: Discus Punch
description: A full planted rotation adds force to a swinging punch to the opponent’s jaw.

name: Diving Double Axe Handle to Floor
Double Axe Handle
description: Both clasped fists are swung down onto the opponent’s upper chest or shoulder line.

name: Double Palm Thrust
description: Both palms drive into the opponent’s chest and force them backward.

name: Ear Clap
description: Both open palms clap sharply against the opponent’s ears.

name: Elbow Jab
description: A very short elbow is tucked into the opponent’s upper body.

name: Elbow Smash
description: A forceful horizontal elbow is swung into the opponent’s head.

name: European Uppercut
description: The upper forearm is driven sharply upward beneath the opponent’s chin.

name: Eye Poke
description: A quick finger jab is directed toward the opponent’s eyes.

name: Foot Stomp
description: The attacker stamps down onto the top of the opponent’s foot.

name: Forearm Strike
description: The inside of the forearm is driven into the opponent’s face.

name: Front Kick
description: The ball or sole of the foot is thrust straight into the opponent’s torso.

name: Gamengiri
description: The attacker jumps from close range and snaps the instep into the side of the opponent’s head.

name: Haymaker
description: A wide, forceful looping punch is swung into the opponent’s jaw.

name: Headbutt
description: The attacker drives the forehead directly into the opponent’s forehead or face.

name: High Roundhouse Kick
description: A fully committed roundhouse swings the shin into the opponent’s head.

name: Hip Check
description: The attacker pivots and bumps the side of the hip into the opponent’s midsection.

name: Hook Kick
description: The leg extends past the opponent and hooks the heel back across the side of the head.

name: Jab
description: A quick lead-hand punch snapped directly into the opponent’s face.

name: Jumping Front Kick
description: The attacker leaps vertically and thrusts one boot into the opponent’s face or upper chest.

name: Jumping Knee Strike
description: A vertical leap drives one knee into the opponent’s face or upper chest.

name: Jumping Roundhouse Kick
description: A vertical leap adds force to a roundhouse kick across the opponent’s head.

name: Jumping Side Kick
description: A short vertical jump carries a side kick into the opponent’s chest.

name: Knee Lift
description: A rising knee is driven into the opponent’s abdomen or lower chest.

name: Knee Strike to Thigh
description: A short knee is bumped into the opponent’s near thigh at close range.

name: Knife-Edge Chop
description: The edge of the open hand is struck sharply across the opponent’s chest.

name: Low Round Kick
description: A short round kick lands against the outside of the opponent’s lead thigh.

name: Mongolian Chop
description: Both hands chop inward at the sides of the opponent’s neck and upper shoulders.

name: Oblique Kick
description: A short stamping kick is driven into the front of the opponent’s lead thigh or knee line.

name: Open-Hand Slap
description: A quick open palm slapped across the opponent’s face.

name: Overhead Chop
description: The open hand is raised and chopped down across the opponent’s upper chest.

name: Palm Strike
description: The heel of the palm is thrust into the opponent’s face.

name: Pump Kick
description: The knee chambers high before the boot is thrust forcefully into the opponent’s face.

name: Ridgehand Strike
description: A curved ridgehand blow is snapped across the side of the opponent’s head.

name: Rising Palm Strike
description: A heavily committed rising palm heel strike drives up beneath the opponent’s chin.

name: Rolling Elbow
description: A committed turning elbow strike is driven across the opponent’s jaw.

name: Roundhouse Kick
description: A turning kick swings the shin or instep into the side of the opponent’s head.

name: Shin Kick
description: The inside edge of the boot is snapped into the opponent’s shin.

name: Short Hook Punch
description: A compact bent-arm punch swung across the opponent’s jaw at close range.

name: Short Uppercut
description: A compact rising fist delivered under the opponent’s chin.

name: Shoulder Thrust
description: A compact forward lunge drives the attacker’s shoulder into the opponent’s abdomen.

name: Side Kick
description: The attacker turns the hip and drives the heel sideways into the opponent’s torso.

name: Spinning Back Elbow
description: The attacker pivots in place and strikes the opponent with the back of the elbow.

name: Spinning Backfist
description: The attacker rotates sharply and drives the back of the fist into the opponent’s head.

name: Spinning Heel Kick
description: A planted spin whips the heel across the opponent’s face.

name: Spinning Side Kick
description: The attacker rotates and drives the heel straight through the opponent’s torso.

name: Standing Dropkick
description: The attacker jumps from both feet and strikes the opponent’s chest with both boots.

name: Superkick
description: A sudden high thrust kick drives the sole of the boot into the opponent’s jaw.

name: Throat Thrust
description: The fingertips or edge of the hand are jabbed into the front of the opponent’s throat.

name: Toe Kick
description: The toe of the boot is kicked into the opponent’s abdomen.
